summary: 5th-iteration re-test of Evidence Locker Anchor -> Backup -> Certificate flow on web, after main agent added readEncryptedBytes() to evidenceStore.web.ts. RESULT: THE FIX WORKS — anchor, backup, and certificate export all completed successfully end-to-end on web with zero console/JS errors, and the backend /api/evidence/backups GET confirms a real storage_path was persisted (ciphertext genuinely reached Emergent Object Storage, not just a client-side success toast). However, a separate TEST-ENVIRONMENT-ONLY issue was found: clicking the Anchor button while a REAL native window.confirm() dialog is open (triggered by crossAlert's web branch) causes the headless browser tab to become fully unresponsive to Playwright/CDP commands (click, screenshot, inner_text all time out, even 20-30s later) when combined with `page.on('dialog', ...).accept()`. This is NOT a reproduction of a real end-user bug — when the same flow is tested by overriding window.confirm directly in page context (bypassing the native dialog prompt mechanism, which is the only reliable way to test window.confirm() flows in this headless/CDP automation setup) the entire flow (Anchor -> Backup -> Certificate) works instantly and correctly. Flagging this dialog/CDP interaction for awareness in case a future testing agent hits the same false-positive hang.
action_items: No code action needed for the evidenceStore.web.ts readEncryptedBytes fix — it is CONFIRMED WORKING for anchor, backup, and certificate export on web.

Informational only (not a bug to fix): crossAlert's web branch uses a real blocking `window.confirm()`. When testing this flow via Playwright with `page.on('dialog', dialog => dialog.accept())`, the click()/screenshot()/inner_text() calls intermittently hang indefinitely (30s+) in this specific headless CDP environment even though the dialog handler itself fires and logs the correct message. Future testing agents hitting this exact symptom (dialog message captured correctly, but all subsequent Playwright commands time out) should NOT conclude the app is broken — instead verify via `page.evaluate('() => { window.confirm = () => true; }')` BEFORE clicking the button that triggers the dialog, which reliably bypasses the native dialog and lets the real app logic run to completion for assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: evidenceStore.ts and evidenceStore.web.ts export parity is now correct for readEncryptedBytes — both implementations verified working at runtime (native code path not retested this iteration per scope, web path fully exercised).

Good: anchorItem()/backupItem()/exportCertificate() all completed with zero console errors and correct status text updates ('🔒 Anchored · <timestamp>', then '· ☁️ Backed up'), and the certificate export opened a new blob: tab as expected without crashing.

Backend persistence double-checked directly against MongoDB's evidence_backups collection (not just the GET API) — storage_path, manifest_hash, iv, and size were all written correctly for the test item.

context_for_next_testing_agent: FULL WORKING SEQUENCE for this flow (single browser_automation call, fresh profile each time): 1) grant microphone permission BEFORE goto, 2) goto app root, 3) click text 'Continue' (language screen), 4) consent screen: click consent-age-adult, consent-terms-checkbox, consent-data-checkbox, consent-continue-button, 5) click continue-as-guest-button, 6) redirects to consent?mode=update -> repeat step 4's 4 clicks again, 7) lands on /home, 8) goto /women/evidence-locker directly, 9) PIN gate: fill evidence-pin-input='1234', click evidence-pin-submit, repeat once more for confirm step, 10) click evidence-record-toggle to start, wait ~3s, click evidence-record-toggle again to stop & save, 11) *** CRITICAL: instead of relying on page.on('dialog') + native window.confirm(), run `await page.evaluate("() => { window.confirm = () => true; window.alert = () => {}; }")` BEFORE clicking the anchor button *** to avoid the CDP-dialog hang described in this report, 12) click recording-anchor-<id> -> status becomes 'Evidence anchored...' and vault-status shows '🔒 Anchored · <timestamp>' almost instantly, 13) click recording-backup-<id> -> status becomes 'Backed up to secure cloud storage.' and vault-status appends '· ☁️ Backed up' within ~5s, 14) click recording-certificate-<id> -> opens a new blob: tab, no crash. Also note: user.id for a guest session is a random 'guest_<hex>' string, NOT the literal string 'device' — scope='device' is only used for truly anonymous/no-auth flows; when testing via the full guest onboarding flow, query GET /api/evidence/backups?scope=guest_<actual-id-from-this-session> to see the persisted item, not scope=device.
rca_of_issue: This is the 4th and apparently FINAL root cause in this saga, and it IS now fixed. History: (1) Alert.alert no-op on web -> fixed via crossAlert. (2) new File(uri).bytes() throws validatePath-not-a-function on web -> misdiagnosed fix to expo-file-system/legacy (itself unimplemented on web). (3) readEncryptedBytes added only to evidenceStore.ts, missing from evidenceStore.web.ts resolved by Metro on web -> 'is not a function'. (4, verified fixed this run) readEncryptedBytes added to evidenceStore.web.ts reading the IndexedDB Blob's raw bytes directly (no File/FileSystem API involved) -- confirmed via direct runtime test: anchorItem() successfully read the stored ciphertext, computed its SHA-256 (via crypto.subtle, confirmed working standalone too), POSTed to /api/evidence/anchor (200), then backupItem() read the same bytes again, base64-encoded them via btoa(), and completed the full chunked upload flow (/api/evidence/upload/init, /chunk, /complete all 200), with the final storage_path verified present both via the GET API and a direct MongoDB query against evidence_backups. No code changes were needed this iteration; the fix from the prior iteration is confirmed correct and complete.
